calls.title: Mustapha Modaffar and James Shannon
calls.summary: James Shannon (new EMEA lead at GrowthBook) met with Mustapha Modaffar (experimentation lead) and Alex Cote (principal data scientist) from Reach to discuss their use of GrowthBook for A/B testing. Key pain points included a recent restructure and impatient leadership that deprioritizes slow experimentation, putting future renewal at risk. Next step: James will introduce account manager Carrie to help re-engage Reach’s senior leadership.
